name: Aura-OS: Autonomous Enterprise Platform
tag: Plan strategy, automate routine tasks and track your market, all by speaking to it.

scenarios.title: Set next quarter's priorities by voice
scenarios.ask: (Spoken) Aura, plan next quarter. We want {growth}% revenue growth with a team of {team}.
steps: Voice intake
Transcribed your request and confirmed the goal back to you in one sentence.
Strategist
Proposed 3 priorities to reach ${=round(revenue * (1 + growth / 100))}: grow existing accounts, one new channel, raise prices on the top plan.
Planner
Turned each priority into goals with owners, about {=max(3, round(team / 3))} owners in total.
Risk check
Flagged that {growth} growth needs about {=max(1, ceil(revenue * growth / 100 / 150000))} new sales hires or faster close rates.
followups: Can I change the plan by talking to it?
Yes. Say something like 'drop the price change and add a partner channel' and Aura redraws the plan and shows what moved.
Aura shows what the target needs in sales and capacity. It's a planning aid, and you decide if the target stands.

scenarios.title: Automate the weekly routine
scenarios.ask: (Spoken) Aura, take over my weekly routine: {reports} reports, team check-ins and the pipeline review.
steps: Task mapper
Listed your weekly tasks by voice: {reports} reports, 1 pipeline review, team check-ins.
Automator
Built a job that pulls the numbers for each report every Friday at 7 AM.
Summarizer
Writes a 5-line spoken summary you can listen to on the drive in.
Follow-up
Creates tasks from anything you say 'follow up on' during the review.
followups: Where does it get the numbers?
From the tools you connect, such as your CRM, accounting and analytics. It only reads what each report needs.
What if a number looks wrong?
Aura marks any number that moved more than usual and tells you where it came from, so you can check before sharing.

scenarios.title: Market watch
scenarios.ask: (Spoken) Aura, keep an eye on {competitors} competitors and tell me what changed this month.
steps: Collector
Checked public pricing pages, job posts and announcements for {competitors} sample competitors.
Analyst
Found {=max(1, round(competitors * 0.6))} notable changes, including a price cut and a new product tier.
Strategist
Rated each change by how much it affects your top plans.
Briefer
Wrote a {=depth * 2}-minute spoken briefing and a one-page note.
followups: Does it use private data about competitors?
No. It only reads public sources such as websites, job posts and press releases.
Weekly by default. You can ask for daily checks on one or two key competitors.
